The '''Corellian Skip Run''' was a secret [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] between [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that was used by most [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clans]] to avoid [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] patrols and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].

==Astrography==
The Corellian Skip Run began at [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and ended at [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. This secret [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] paralleled the [[Old Corellian Run]] without saving much [[Time/Legends|time]], but it avoided [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] patrols and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].<ref name="LoNH" />

The Corellian Skip Run intersected the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], the [[Death Wind Corridor/Legends|Death Wind Corridor]] and the [[Ryloth Road]] at Ryloth, and [[The Crystal Passage/Legends|the Crystal Passage]], the [[Tatooine Dash]] and the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] at Tatooine.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="LoNH" />
